name: Fuyuko Asaka
source:
Despite being a woman, Fuyuko is known as "the heartless prince" of the school. Due to her good looks and cool personality, she is both effortlessly popular and wildly infamous. But she doesn’t enjoy her fame, rejecting and scorning all of her fans.

Fuyuko is serious, bitter, and naturally sadistic. She struggles with episodes of depression and apathy, and takes a path of delinquency and truancy: skipping classes, fighting, and smoking.

Fuyuko tries to seduce Melissa with secret intentions. She is at the heart of the scandal surrounding the bride’s murder. Groom.
